116-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-4613-6857.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2393-4279-4616--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-4616--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3899-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
3899-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7725-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4862-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
4862-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4170-4762-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Marvin using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
4170-4762-5963.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Fain's third ability to create infinite Inklings, then use Fain's fourth ability to untap Marvin. You then can also use Fain's first ability to get infinite +1/+1 counters.

2034-5086-5183-6705-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6705-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2079-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5232-5718-6991.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Donnie & April.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Donnie & April.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Donnie & April.
Repeat from step 2.

1400-2438-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-2438-4619.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2942-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Fiery Emancipation.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

413-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Felidar Guardian targeting Vesperlark.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
Vesperlark leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering it and Blasting Station, with Vesperlark targeting Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Vesperlark trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

671-1274-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-3197.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-5365-5929-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}
Repeat.
2060-5365-5929-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Crystalline Crawler for additional mana.

101-4067-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
101-4067-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

3432-3858-6593.description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting a creature you control.
Resolve Star of Extinction, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. The creature targeted by Gatta and Luzzu will not be dealt damage, and will instead have twenty +1/+1 counters put on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

225-1479-2783-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-2783-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4823-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4823-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3750-5453.notablePrerequisites:
Enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
You control at least one land that does not have a Settlement token attached to it, or enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
An opponent cannot block and kill Preston.
3750-5453.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Preston's first ability triggers, putting a Settlement Aura token onto the battlefield attached to a land you control.
Declare Preston as an attacker.
Preston's second ability triggers, untapping each enchanted permanent you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of enchanted permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1315-1863-3946.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional land.
Your life total is at least three.
1315-1863-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, causing you to put an age counter on it and lose 2 life.
Play any land from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Glacial Chasm, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, doing nothing.
Repeat.

696-2816-3094-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least six charge counters on it.
Umbral Mantle attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
696-2816-3094-4091.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2395-4508-4971.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2395-4508-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

724-1636-3693-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
724-1636-3693-5220.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Walking Ballista from the top of your library and allowing you cast it this turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Walking Ballista from exile by paying an arbitrarily large amount of mana, causing Walking Ballista to enter with half that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 10.

907-1479-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-3678.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

225-539-2248-3257.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
